list.text: \f[facelt.surge]Lt. Surge: Hey, you little tyke, so you're back.\nYou and Red gave us trouble back at Mt. Moon - didn’t think you had it in you.
\f[facelt.surge]It may not be very smart to challenge me, but it takes guts!
\f[facelt.surge]When it comes to Electric-type Pokemon, I'm number one!
\f[facelt.surge]I've never lost on the battlefield.
\f[facelt.surge]I'll zap you just like I do all my enemies in battle!

then.text: \PN received the Thunder Badge from Lt. Surge!
\f[facelt.surge]Kanto needs strength. Needs leadership. And Giovanni… Giovanni knows how to get things done. He’s got a plan - a real plan - to make Kanto strong again.\nThat’s why I’m backing him.
\f[facelt.surge]A trainer like you should understand. Power decides everything in the end.\nGiovanni knows that.\nAnd I’m making sure I’m on the winning side.
\f[facelt.surge]I need to go, the elections will be starting soon.

lines: These are two different switches, the 767 is DEACTIVATED after the elections happen

\f[facelt.surge]To prove I regret my actions, I'll give you this.

\f[facelt.surge]With this item you'll be able to see through their psychic barrier.
\f[facelt.surge]It won't be easy, but I think you have what it takes to stop all this.
